title: Focused · adj
subtitle: 「專注的／留心的／目標明確的」，究竟是哪一種 focused？
description: 「專注的／留心的／目標明確的」，究竟是哪一種 focused？

words.note: 最直接的近義詞之一，當 focused 指注意力集中在某項工作、問題或目標上時很自然；常見於學習、工作和分析語境。
words.example: She remained concentrated throughout the difficult calculation.
words.exampleZh: 她在整個困難計算過程中都保持專注。

exercises.original: She stayed focused while checking the figures for errors.
exercises.zh: 她檢查數字是否有錯時一直保持專注。
exercises.upgrade: concentrated · 專注的；集中精神的

options.explanation: busy = busy 只表示有事做，不能表達她把注意力集中在檢查錯誤上。
calm = calm 只表示情緒平靜，不等於專注檢查。
concentrated = 逐項核對 figures 需要持續集中注意力，因此 concentrated 最自然。
organized = 有條理可能有幫助，但不代表注意力集中。
interested = 有興趣不足以說明持續專注。
quiet = 安靜不表示正在集中精神。

exercises.original: The technician remained focused during the delicate repair.
exercises.zh: 技術員在精細維修期間一直保持專注。
exercises.upgrade: concentrated · 專注的；集中精神的

options.explanation: serious = 維修可能很嚴肅，但重點是注意力集中。
determined = 決心不等於當下的專注狀態。
busy = 忙碌不代表集中精神。
concentrated = delicate repair 需要高度注意細節，concentrated 最貼切。
relaxed = 和 delicate repair 所需的高度集中不符。
curious = 好奇不是精細操作所需的集中。

exercises.original: He looked focused as he worked through the final calculations.
exercises.zh: 他處理最後計算時看起來非常專注。
exercises.upgrade: concentrated · 專注的；集中精神的

options.explanation: organized = 不能描述當下注意力狀態。
calm = 可同時冷靜，但句子重點是 calculation 上的集中。
interested = 興趣不足以表達全神貫注。
serious = 表情嚴肅和專注不是同一回事。
concentrated = 做 final calculations 時的注意力集中，最適合 concentrated。
busy = 只表示工作量。

words.note: 當 focused 強調仔細聆聽、觀察或留意細節時最自然；比 concentrated 更突出對外界資訊的注意。
words.example: The students were attentive during the safety briefing.
words.exampleZh: 學生在安全簡報期間都很專心。

exercises.original: The children stayed focused while the guide explained the safety rules.
exercises.zh: 導遊講解安全規則時，孩子們一直專心聆聽。
exercises.upgrade: attentive · 專心的；留心的

options.explanation: determined = 聽講時主要不是意志堅定。
busy = 沒有多項工作。
quiet = 就算安靜也可能沒有真正聽。
attentive = 聽 safety rules 時重點是仔細留意講解內容，attentive 最精確。
organized = 不合聽講語境。
calm = 平靜不等於有留心內容。

exercises.original: The nurse was focused on every change in the patient's condition.
exercises.zh: 護士留心病人狀況的每一個變化。
exercises.upgrade: attentive · 專心的；留心的

options.explanation: interested = 醫護人員不只是感興趣，而是必須持續留意。
serious = 態度嚴肅不代表察覺每個變化。
quiet = 不相關。
determined = 不表示對細節的注意。
attentive = attentive to every change 是很自然的搭配，強調留意細節。
organized = 不表示感知變化。

exercises.original: She remained focused throughout the client's explanation.
exercises.zh: 她在客戶整段解釋期間都很專心。
exercises.upgrade: attentive · 專心的；留心的

options.explanation: busy = 不合聆聽語境。
calm = 情緒平靜不等於有仔細聽。
organized = 不合。
curious = 可能好奇，但未必持續專心。
silent = 保持沉默也可能走神。
attentive = 長時間聆聽他人解釋，attentive 比 general focused 更具體。

words.note: 當 focused 指行動有清楚方向、不是漫無目的時可用；比 attentive 更強調目的和意圖。
words.example: She approached the project in a purposeful way.
words.exampleZh: 她以目標明確的方式處理這個項目。

exercises.original: Her focused approach helped the team avoid unnecessary work.
exercises.zh: 她有目的、有方向的做法幫助團隊避免不必要的工作。
exercises.upgrade: purposeful · 有目的的；目標明確的

options.explanation: busy = 忙碌 approach 不自然，亦不表示有方向。
quiet = 不合工作方法。
interested = 有興趣不等於工作有清晰目的。
calm = 平靜不是 approach 的主要特徵。
purposeful = 避免 unnecessary work 顯示方法有清晰目的，因此 purposeful 很自然。
serious = 可以認真，但不等於有明確方向。

exercises.original: The discussion became more focused once the group agreed on its main objective.
exercises.zh: 小組同意主要目標後，討論變得更有方向。
exercises.upgrade: purposeful · 有目的的；目標明確的

options.explanation: organized = 可能更有組織，但句子強調 main objective 帶來目的性。
quiet = 不相關。
determined = 通常形容人，不自然修飾 discussion。
interested = 不合。
calm = 和 objective 無直接關係。
purposeful = main objective 是 purposeful discussion 的直接線索。

exercises.original: His focused questions moved the meeting toward a decision.
exercises.zh: 他有目的的提問推動會議走向決定。
exercises.upgrade: purposeful · 有目的的；目標明確的

options.explanation: purposeful = 問題明確推動 meeting toward a decision，因此 purposeful 最貼切。
serious = 問題嚴肅不一定能推動決策。
busy = 不能自然形容 questions。
quiet = 不合。
interested = 有興趣的問題不等於目標明確。
random = 和 toward a decision 的方向性相反。

words.note: 較書面，常用於 intent on 或形容表情、目光和注意力，表示非常專心、不受干擾。
words.example: He was intent on finishing the report before noon.
words.exampleZh: 他全神貫注於在中午前完成報告。

exercises.original: She was focused on finishing the analysis before the meeting began.
exercises.zh: 她全神貫注於在會議開始前完成分析。
exercises.upgrade: intent · 專注的；全神貫注的

options.explanation: interested = interested in 只表示興趣，沒有同等程度的專注和決心。
quiet = 不合 on finishing 結構與語義。
organized = 不自然接 on finishing。
calm = 平靜不代表全神貫注。
busy = 忙着做不等於專注於一定完成。
intent = intent on + -ing 是固定搭配，表示全神貫注於完成某事。

exercises.original: He was so focused on the screen that he did not notice anyone enter.
exercises.zh: 他全神貫注看着螢幕，沒有留意有人進來。
exercises.upgrade: intent · 專注的；全神貫注的

options.explanation: intent = so ... that he did not notice 顯示高度集中，intent 很自然。
serious = 嚴肅看螢幕不等於專注到忽略周圍。
calm = 不合。
organized = 不合視線專注。
interested = 有興趣的程度未必足以解釋沒注意到別人。
busy = 不能自然接 on the screen 表達凝視。

exercises.original: Her focused expression showed that she was listening carefully.
exercises.zh: 她專注的表情顯示她正在仔細聆聽。
exercises.upgrade: intent · 專注的；全神貫注的

options.explanation: quiet = quiet expression 不自然且不表示專注。
intent = intent expression 是自然搭配，表示神情專注。
busy = 不能形容 expression。
organized = 不能形容表情。
calm = 可形容表情，但沒有 attentive concentration 的意味。
cheerful = 和專注程度無關。

words.meaning: 全神貫注的；沉浸其中的
words.note: 當 focused 指某人非常投入閱讀、工作或活動，以至於很少注意周圍環境時最貼切。
words.example: She was absorbed in the novel and did not hear the phone ring.
words.exampleZh: 她全神貫注地看小說，沒有聽到電話響。

exercises.original: She was completely focused on the book and missed her stop.
exercises.zh: 她完全沉浸在書中，以致坐過了站。
exercises.upgrade: absorbed · 全神貫注的；沉浸其中的

options.explanation: absorbed = missed her stop 顯示投入到忽略周圍，最自然是 absorbed in。
organized = 不合閱讀沉浸感。
determined = 不是意志問題。
quiet = 安靜讀書不等於沉浸到坐過站。
interested = 有興趣太弱，不能充分解釋 missed her stop。
calm = 不合。

exercises.original: He became so focused on the puzzle that he forgot about lunch.
exercises.zh: 他太投入解謎，以致忘了吃午飯。
exercises.upgrade: absorbed · 全神貫注的；沉浸其中的

options.explanation: busy = 忙不一定因單一 activity 而忘記吃飯。
absorbed = 對 puzzle 沉浸到忘記時間，absorbed 最精確。
serious = 認真不一定如此投入。
attentive = 通常指留意外界資訊，不如 absorbed 表示沉浸。
organized = 忘記 lunch 反而不像有條理。
calm = 不合。

exercises.original: The children were focused on the game and ignored the noise outside.
exercises.zh: 孩子們投入遊戲，沒有理會外面的聲音。
exercises.upgrade: absorbed · 全神貫注的；沉浸其中的

options.explanation: quiet = 孩子是否安靜和忽略噪音不是同一件事。
interested = 程度不足以表達忽略外界聲音。
absorbed = ignored the noise outside 是 absorbed 的典型結果。
determined = game 不是長期目標。
organized = 不合。
serious = 不一定。

words.note: 當 focused 指某人積極參與、思考或投入活動時可用；尤其常見於學習、會議和互動語境。
words.example: The class stayed engaged during the discussion.
words.exampleZh: 全班在討論期間都保持投入。

exercises.original: The students stayed focused during the group discussion and responded to each other's ideas.
exercises.zh: 學生在小組討論中保持投入，並回應彼此的想法。
exercises.upgrade: engaged · 投入的；專心參與的

options.explanation: quiet = group discussion 中 quiet 甚至與積極互動相反。
engaged = responded to each other's ideas 顯示積極參與，因此 engaged 最自然。
organized = 不表示實際參與。
serious = 未必需要嚴肅。
calm = 不等於積極參與。
determined = 不是堅持某一目標。

exercises.original: The audience remained focused throughout the workshop because the activities were interactive.
exercises.zh: 活動具有互動性，因此觀眾整個工作坊都保持投入。
exercises.upgrade: engaged · 投入的；專心參與的

options.explanation: interested = 接近，但 interactive activities 更強調持續參與而非單純興趣。
quiet = 互動活動未必安靜。
engaged = interactive 直接支持 participant engagement。
busy = 不是同時忙其他事情。
organized = 不合 audience state。
calm = 不表示參與度。

exercises.original: Employees seemed more focused after the trainer began asking questions.
exercises.zh: 培訓員開始提問後，員工看起來更投入。
exercises.upgrade: engaged · 投入的；專心參與的

options.explanation: serious = 提問未必令大家更嚴肅。
quiet = 可能反而更多人說話。
determined = 不是毅力問題。
engaged = trainer asking questions 提升互動參與度，engaged 最精確。
organized = 不合。
calm = 不合。

words.meaning: 一心一意的；專注單一目標的
words.note: 當 focused 指某人長時間把注意力和努力集中在一個主要目標上時很自然；語氣比 concentrated 更強。
words.example: She was single-minded in her pursuit of the championship.

exercises.original: She remained focused on winning the championship despite several setbacks.
exercises.zh: 儘管遇到多次挫折，她仍一心一意爭取冠軍。
exercises.upgrade: single-minded · 一心一意的；專注單一目標的

options.explanation: attentive = 只表示留心當下，不足以表達長期追求單一目標。
busy = 不合。
single-minded = despite several setbacks + long-term goal 表示堅定集中於單一目標，single-minded 最合適。
calm = 未表達持續目標。
organized = 規劃有序不等於一心一意。
interested = 興趣遠弱於 championship pursuit。

exercises.original: His focused pursuit of the research question lasted for years.
exercises.zh: 他多年來一心一意研究這個問題。
exercises.upgrade: single-minded · 一心一意的；專注單一目標的

options.explanation: quiet = 不合 pursuit。
serious = 可能認真，但不能表達多年只集中在一個方向。
attentive = 較像短期注意力。
single-minded = pursuit + lasted for years 是 single-minded 的典型語境。
busy = 不合。
curious = 好奇不足以表達 years of pursuit。

exercises.original: The athlete was highly focused on one objective: qualifying for the Olympics.
exercises.zh: 這名運動員高度專注於一個目標：取得奧運資格。
exercises.upgrade: single-minded · 一心一意的；專注單一目標的

options.explanation: organized = 可能有規劃，但不等於全部精力集中於單一目標。
calm = 不合。
interested = 程度過弱。
quiet = 不合。
single-minded = one objective 是 single-minded 的直接線索。
engaged = 可以投入訓練，但沒有 single objective 的排他性。

words.meaning: 目標導向的；以目標為中心的
words.note: 當 focused 指工作方式圍繞清晰目標和結果安排時很自然；常見於職場、教育和個人發展語境。
words.example: He is highly goal-oriented and plans each project carefully.
words.exampleZh: 他非常目標導向，會仔細規劃每個項目。

exercises.original: The team is highly focused and measures every task against its quarterly targets.
exercises.zh: 團隊非常目標導向，會按季度目標衡量每項任務。
exercises.upgrade: goal-oriented · 目標導向的；以目標為中心的

options.explanation: quiet = 不合工作方式。
busy = 工作多不代表以目標為導向。
attentive = 注意細節不等於圍繞 targets 安排工作。
goal-oriented = quarterly targets 明確表示工作圍繞目標安排，最自然是 goal-oriented。
calm = 不合。
interested = 不合。

exercises.original: She has a focused working style and sets measurable objectives for every project.
exercises.zh: 她的工作方式很有目標導向，每個項目都會設定可量度目標。
exercises.upgrade: goal-oriented · 目標導向的；以目標為中心的

options.explanation: serious = 認真不等於以 measurable objectives 管理工作。
organized = 接近，但 organized 強調秩序，不一定以結果目標為中心。
quiet = 不合。
calm = 不合。
goal-oriented = measurable objectives 是 goal-oriented 的核心線索。
absorbed = 表示投入某一活動，不是整體工作風格。

exercises.original: The programme encourages students to become more focused by planning clear outcomes.
exercises.zh: 這個課程鼓勵學生透過規劃清晰成果，變得更有目標導向。
exercises.upgrade: goal-oriented · 目標導向的；以目標為中心的

options.explanation: busy = 多做事情不等於設定 outcomes。
attentive = 留心課堂不等於長期目標管理。
calm = 不合。
quiet = 不合。
interested = 沒有目標管理的意思。
goal-oriented = planning clear outcomes 直接對應 goal orientation。

words.meaning: 高度專注的；極度聚焦的
words.note: 較口語、現代，表示注意力非常集中在一件事或一個目標上，幾乎不受其他事情干擾。
words.example: The team stayed laser-focused on reducing delivery times.
words.exampleZh: 團隊高度專注於縮短送貨時間。

exercises.original: The team stayed focused on reducing delivery times despite several side projects.
exercises.zh: 儘管還有幾個支線項目，團隊仍高度專注於縮短送貨時間。
exercises.upgrade: laser-focused · 高度專注的；極度聚焦的

options.explanation: busy = side projects 正說明他們很忙，但核心是沒有被分散注意。
organized = 有條理不等於把幾乎全部注意力集中在一件事。
calm = 不合工作優先次序。
interested = 程度太弱。
laser-focused = despite several side projects 顯示沒有被分散注意，laser-focused 很貼切。
quiet = 完全無關。

exercises.original: She was focused on one task for the entire afternoon and ignored every notification.
exercises.zh: 她整個下午高度專注於一項工作，忽略了所有通知。
exercises.upgrade: laser-focused · 高度專注的；極度聚焦的

options.explanation: attentive = attentive 可表示留心，但不如 laser-focused 強調排除干擾。
busy = 忙碌未必只做一件事。
organized = 不合 ignored every notification 的集中程度。
calm = 不表示注意力集中。
serious = 語氣仍不足。
laser-focused = one task + ignored every notification 明確是極高集中度。

exercises.original: Management became focused on fixing the product defect and postponed less urgent work.
exercises.zh: 管理層高度聚焦修復產品缺陷，並推遲較不緊急的工作。
exercises.upgrade: laser-focused · 高度專注的；極度聚焦的

options.explanation: laser-focused = 推遲其他工作以全力處理 defect，最能體現 laser-focused。
interested = 修復 defect 不是單純感興趣。
organized = 延期其他工作是 priority focus，不只是有條理。
quiet = 不合。
calm = 不合。
engaged = 可以投入，但沒有同等的排除其他優先事項意味。

falseSynonyms.zh: 忙碌不等於 focused busy 只表示有很多事情做；一個人可以很忙但注意力分散。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Someone can be busy without being focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 認真不一定等於 focused serious 表示態度嚴肅或重視事情；focused 更具體指注意力或努力集中。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Serious describes attitude; focused describes concentration or direction.

falseSynonyms.zh: 安靜不等於 focused quiet 只表示聲音少；一個安靜的人仍可能走神。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Being quiet does not necessarily mean being focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有興趣不一定等於 focused interested 表示感興趣；focused 還包含持續注意和集中精力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Interest may attract attention, but focus requires sustained concentration.

falseSynonyms.zh: 冷靜不等於 focused calm 表示情緒平靜；一個人可以冷靜但沒有集中注意。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Calm describes emotional state; focused describes attention.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有條理不等於 focused organized 表示安排井然有序；focused 表示注意力和努力集中在特定任務或目標。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An organized person may still be distracted.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有決心不完全等於 focused determined 強調不放棄的意志；focused 強調注意力和方向。兩者常同時出現，但不是同義。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Determination is persistence; focus is concentration and direction.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞／動詞與形容詞不同 focus 可作名詞或動詞；focused 是形容詞，描述人、注意力、工作或策略處於集中狀態。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Focus can be a noun or verb. Focused is an adjective.
